lina: quick design review — proposal for adding inline "rollback comments" inside the version timeline. goal: let engineers add a short rationale when they trigger a rollback so downstream teams see context in the history. mock: https://redwood.design/snap/rollback-comment-02.png :memo: raj: love the idea. question: do comments live as part of the rollback event or as a separate annotation pinned to that version? current mock shows a small speech-bubble chip attached to the rollback pill. maria: product: prefer attaching to the rollback event itself so it flows with auditing. but allow quick replies as a threaded comment to avoid clutter. emma: a11y items: ensure the chip has a clear accessible name like "Rollback note: " and is keyboard focusable. if it expands to show full text, use aria-expanded and a logical focus order. sam: copy debate: short placeholder copy ideas: A) "Add a note (why the rollback?)" B) "Explain reason for rollback (optional)" C) "What's the cause?" which is concise? lina: prefer B — explicit optional flag reduces pressure. also add a 280-char limit with character counter. emma: show code snippet for aria pattern suggestion: ```
``` raj: UX concern: if people add long comments, timeline height will grow. propose collapsing to 2-line preview with "Show more" to expand in-place. we should also stack replies under the same event. maria: from compliance: all rollback notes must be immutable after submit, with an audit record showing who edited (or that it was created). we should disable edit but allow follow-up annotations. emma: contrast + color: the speech-bubble chip uses a pale yellow currently; need 4.5:1 contrast with text. suggest using a 1px darker border and darker text. also ensure focus ring meets visible requirements. sam: dev ask: should submitting a note be synchronous? we have autosave drafts, but for audit we need final saved event timestamp. propose save on submit and autosave drafts in local state until confirmed. lina: good. acceptance criteria for this ticket: 1) UI for adding a rollback note (placeholder B), 2) 280-char limit with counter, 3) immutable after submit and shown with author+timestamp, 4) collapsed two-line preview + show more, 5) accessible patterns (aria-expanded, region, keyboard), 6) telemetry event on create. emma: also add keyboard shortcut to open note composer when a rollback event is focused: press "N" to create note. make sure it's documented and only active when timeline has focus to avoid conflicts. raj: rough estimate: 3 dev days + 1 QA + 0.5 a11y review. I'll flag dependency on timeline virtualization - expanding items needs to pin and scroll into view. maria: legal/product: please include language about retention: notes are retained per org retention policy and surfaced in exports. also we need redaction flow for PII requests. lina: noted. maria will draft retention + redaction text for the modal. emma, can you add the a11y checklist lines? emma: will do. checklist items I'll add: keyboard nav of chips, aria-expanded use, live region for save success, visible focus states, contrast verification, screen reader readout of author+timestamp on open. deploy-bot: automated: rollback-event detected for deployment=svc-payments v=3.4.1 at 2026-03-23T16:30:00Z by carlos. sam: I'll add a feature flag so we can test opt-in on beta orgs. we can A/B test adoption and whether notes reduce incident triage time. lina: thanks all. follow-ups: @raj create PR with mock implementation, @maria draft retention & redaction copy, @emma update a11y checklist, @sam add feature flag and telemetry event name proposal. :rocket:
